Thanks Michaela — appreciate the context and the attachments. Copying Laura from Procurement and Neha (who supports small vendor flows) so we can evaluate.

Short answer: Redwood’s baseline is that new vendors are set up with a PO number prior to provisioning. That said, we do have a limited temporary "invoice-only" intake for low-risk, small-dollar pilots with explicit guardrails. Typical requirements we’d ask for (subject to procurement review):

- Completed vendor intake form (got it) + W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax docs
- SOC2 summary or equivalent security evidence (got it — thanks)
- Signed MSA or a short-term SOW with a liability cap, or an agreed one-page addendum allowing invoice-only for 90 days
- Cap on exposure (e.g., $25k max across the pilot period)
- Monthly statements and a named Redwood billing contact for rapid reconciliation

Laura — can you confirm whether procurement can approve a 90-day invoice-only path for QuickLedger under these conditions? If helpful, Ben and I can propose language for the addendum and a deal_id to attach.

Michaela — if you can share W-9 and bank remit (or the equivalent procurement docs) that will speed things up.

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi all — thanks Sergio and Michaela. I reviewed the intake docs and QuickLedger's SOC2 summary. Procurement can support a temporary invoice-only onboarding under the following conditional approval:

Required items before provisioning:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we have that)
- W-9 (or equivalent tax cert)
- Proof of general liability insurance or vendor insurance waiver
- Bank remit details + completed ACH form (for payments)
- Signed MSA or a short 1-page addendum approving a temporary NET30 invoice path

Temporary approval terms (procurement):
- NET30 invoice-only for up to 90 days from provisioning start date
- Cumulative exposure limited to $25,000 across the 90-day window
- Monthly invoices required with itemized usage; Redwood will not accept backdated adjustments after 45 days
- QuickLedger must provide SOC2 evidence within 30 days if not already in baton; if gaps exist, we will add compensating controls (e.g., IP scoping, limited data retention)
- Procurement reserves the right to require PO issuance at any time if exposure exceeds thresholds or if risk posture changes

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (procurement checklist)

Next steps for Michaela: please upload W-9, proof of insurance (or request a waiver), bank remit, and sign the attached one-page addendum. Once procurement confirms documents, ops will provision a billing relationship and assign a temporary vendor id.

Happy to review the addendum language if Sergio/Ben produce a draft.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
